outage_experiment.sample_rule: seeded flight sample from September validation with >=20 original ADS-B positions; score only originally observed intervals

protocol.fallback: type-rate if ADS-B position count is zero; otherwise Phase 3 ADS-B HistGB
protocol.note: Frozen before October model scoring. October label distribution was inspected descriptively during data preparation, but no October model error or selection result was used to choose this protocol. September validation and October are evaluation periods, not tuning sets.
protocol.primary_selector: predicted absolute error, trained on September 1-9 residuals
